mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `student_auth_request` WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `student_auth_request` (user_id, real_name, school, college, major, grade, class_name, student_no, student_card_img, status, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{realName}, #{school}, #{college}, #{major}, #{grade}, #{className}, #{studentNo}, #{studentCardImg}, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE `student_auth_request` SET real_name = #{realName}, school = #{school}, college = #{college}, major = #{major}, grade = #{grade}, class_name = #{className}, student_no = #{studentNo}, student_card_img = #{studentCardImg} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `student_auth_request` SET status = #{status}, reason = #{reason}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
